sources.title: johninthepool/Qwen3.8-27B-MTPLX-4bit · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A 4-bit MLX build of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B for Apple Silicon, produced with mtplx forge. Unlike a standard mlx_lm.convert quantization, this build preserves the model's native multi-token-prediction (MTP) head instead of discarding it, so it runs with real speculative decoding on mtplx — not just a quantized weight dump.
